title: The Ark Brought to the Temple

questions.question: Who brought up the ark of the covenant to the temple?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:3-4 (ESV): "...And the priests took up the ark. And they brought up the ark of the LORD ... and the priests and the Levites brought them up."

questions.question: What was inside the ark when it was brought into the temple?
options: Assume pot of manna and Aaron's rod too
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:9 (ESV): "There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets of stone that Moses put there at Horeb..."

questions.question: What happened when the priests came out of the Holy Place?
options: A cloud filled the house of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: A cloud filled the house of the LORD
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:10 (ESV): "And when the priests came out of the Holy Place, a cloud filled the house of the LORD..."

questions.question: How did Solomon bless the assembly of Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:22 (ESV): "Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the assembly of Israel... and spread out his hands toward heaven..."

questions.question: Solomon prayed that God would hear prayers directed toward what?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:29 (ESV): "...that your eyes may be open night and day toward this house... that you may listen to the prayer that your servant offers toward this place."

questions.question: Solomon acknowledged that heaven and the highest heaven cannot ______ God.
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:27 (ESV): "But will God indeed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the highest heaven cannot contain you; how much less this house that I have built!"

questions.question: What specific scenarios did Solomon mention in his prayer for forgiveness?
options: Sin against neighbor, defeat by enemy, drought, famine
questions.correctAnswer: Sin against neighbor, defeat by enemy, drought, famine
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:31, 33, 35, 37 mentions these scenarios (and foreigner, battle, captivity).

questions.question: What did Solomon pray for regarding foreigners?
options: That God would hear them so all peoples may know His name
questions.correctAnswer: That God would hear them so all peoples may know His name
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:43 (ESV): "...hear in heaven your dwelling place... in order that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you..."

questions.question: How many peace offerings of oxen did Solomon offer?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:63 (ESV): "Solomon offered as peace offerings... 22,000 oxen and 120,000 sheep."

questions.question: How long was the feast of dedication?
options: Seven days and seven days, fourteen days in all
questions.correctAnswer: Seven days and seven days, fourteen days in all
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:65 (ESV): "...seven days and seven days, fourteen days."

questions.question: Solomon said there is no man who does not ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:46 (ESV): "If they sin against you—for there is no one who does not sin..."

questions.question: Where did the ark specifically rest?
options: Underneath the wings of the cherubim
questions.correctAnswer: Underneath the wings of the cherubim
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:6 (ESV): "...underneath the wings of the cherubim."

questions.question: What feast was held at the time of dedication?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:2 (ESV): "And all the men of Israel assembled... at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month." (This is contextually the Feast of Tabernacles).

questions.question: Why did Solomon consecrate the middle of the court?
options: Because the bronze altar was too small for the burnt offerings
questions.correctAnswer: Because the bronze altar was too small for the burnt offerings
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:64 (ESV): "...for the bronze altar that was before the LORD was too small to receive the burnt offering..."

questions.question: In which month did the dedication take place?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 8:2 (ESV): "...in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month."

key_verse_text: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the highest heaven cannot contain you; how much less this house that I have built! (ESV)
